title: ADR approval of the derived reconstruction, closing SRC-001

acceptance_gates.description: Every [DECISION] in the derived schema and its companion is covered by an accepted ADR, verified by an executable check rather than asserted.
The activity timeouts are ADR-approved, and the four retry policies v1.2 states are encoded, applied to the SDK call, and asserted against literal values without a Temporal server.
SRC-001 is closed with issue #2's close criterion quoted and each clause answered by a named ADR, including where the answer is narrower than the criterion's literal wording.

rollback: Revert the FND-SPEC-002 commits and set SRC-001 back to open; no schema, migration or cloud resource is created, so rollback has no data implications.
